title: The Tide Marks
narration: Every morning, wet footprints appeared beside my bed. A dripping boy led me to names and rising lines hidden beneath the wallpaper. They recorded floods, and the highest mark bore tomorrow's date. An engineer discovered the cottage blocked an old storm channel while my landlord had concealed every warning. We evacuated before the tide destroyed the building. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. The silence felt deliberate, as though someone nearby was waiting for me to understand the trap before moving again. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Rescuers found the boy's skeleton below the floor; his ghost had been warning us about the water that killed him.
